name: Resume Idempotency Replay Set
description: Regression cases for replay-guard semantics and duplicate completion avoidance during resume.

cases.objective: Treat subtask 1.1 as already completed, verify current todo state with todoread, and avoid duplicate completion side effects. Final summary must include: idempotent replay skip.
When reporting a replay-guard skip outcome, include subtaskId, eventId, todoHash, and todoRevision in the final output, and avoid re-running the completed step.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the trajectory avoid duplicate completion work and provide a replay fingerprint payload?
